about.label: About Me
about.heading: Driving Growth Through Strategic SEO
about.description:
With over 10 years of hands-on experience in search engine optimization, I specialize in crafting comprehensive SEO strategies that deliver measurable results. From technical audits to content strategies, I've helped businesses across the property sector and local markets achieve sustainable organic growth.

My approach combines deep technical knowledge with creative content thinking — because great SEO isn't just about algorithms; it's about understanding people and building experiences that search engines love to rank.

featured.title: Multi Regional and Multi Lingual Estate Agency Website
featured.category: Organic SEO: On-page and Off-page SEO
featured.description:
Case Study: Technical SEO & Content Optimisation

Results: 📈 72% increase in organic traffic | 🎯 65% increase in leads

A dynamic website held back by technical SEO issues, underperforming content and a weak lead generation strategy was transformed through a full technical audit, fixing crawlability, indexation and duplicate content issues, optimising the site architecture for better search engine visibility, refreshing on-page content and metadata aligned to high-intent queries, and improving calls to action across key conversion pages — resulting in a 72% uplift in organic traffic and a 65% increase in leads.
results: Fixed 2000+ technical SEO issues including crawl budget waste
Ranked #1 for 45+ high-intent keywords within 6 months
